item.description:

Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-05 Sociologia generale

Title of the project:" The Historic City Centre in Transition: New Populations, Urban Practices, and Socio-Spatial Inequalities ". The research activity will focus on the design, implementation and analysis of a multidimensional study investigating the representations, perceptions and patterns of use of Bologna’s historic center, in support of the Integrated Strategy promoted by the Municipality of Bologna. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Comparative evaluation procedure for n. 1 post-doc research contract - Department of the Arts (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-30 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-06 Sociologia dei processi culturali e comunicativi

Title of the project:" Hostile Environments - London Research". As part of the ERC-funded research project ‘Hostile Environments: The Political Ecology of Migration and Border Violence’, this research will focus on forms of everyday bordering - mundane practices of exclusion, that make it impossible to live a normal life for those racialised as migrants, regardless of their juridical status or whether or not they have recently crossed international borders - in London, UK. item.title: Incarico di ricerca: Neighborhood Tourism and Cultural Heritagization: Participation and Social Innovation (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-30 12:00
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Political and social sciences / 14/GSPS-07 Sociologia della politica, del diritto e della devianza

The research program aims to address the cognitive demand for identifying strategies, processes, and products for the protection and enhancement of the environmental, social, economic, cultural, and tourism heritage of the Palermo area. Specifically, it focuses on "informal heritage"—heritage recognized as such by residents but connected to practices that do not comply with legal regulations.
